::: {.qs-about-identity}
::: {.qs-about-identity-copy .qs-about-story}
I try to understand how environmental variability, population processes, and fishing shape the distribution, abundance, productivity, and life-history strategies of pelagic fish. I address these questions primarily in the [**Humboldt Current System**](projects/), with particular emphasis on Peruvian anchovy, by combining fishery observations, scientific surveys, environmental information, and statistical, spatial, and stock-assessment models.

I am based at the [**Instituto del Mar del Perú (IMARPE)**](https://www.gob.pe/imarpe), where I work on quantitative analyses of pelagic resources and fisheries. My research spans [**stock assessment and population dynamics**](projects/#stock-assessment), [**environmental variability**](projects/#environmental-variability), [**reproduction, growth and condition**](projects/#life-history), [**spatial ecology and biodiversity**](projects/#spatial-biodiversity), and [**fisheries dynamics and adaptive management**](projects/#fisheries-dynamics).

I also enjoy turning recurring analytical problems into reproducible methods and [**open research software**](software/). Across these themes, I aim to connect ecological mechanisms with decision-relevant evidence, especially changes that biomass alone may not reveal, including recruitment, growth, maturity, condition, availability, and spatial distribution.
:::

## Research interests

<div class="qs-interest-grid">
<a href="projects/#stock-assessment"><strong>Stock assessment & population dynamics</strong><span>Productivity, recruitment, mortality, selectivity, model diagnostics, and structural uncertainty.</span></a>
<a href="projects/#environmental-variability"><strong>Environmental variability</strong><span>Climate and oceanographic forcing, pressure-state relationships, thresholds, and regime change.</span></a>
<a href="projects/#life-history"><strong>Reproduction, growth & condition</strong><span>Maturity, spawning, growth, condition, and life-history variation beyond biomass alone.</span></a>
<a href="projects/#spatial-biodiversity"><strong>Spatial ecology & biodiversity</strong><span>Species distributions, habitat suitability, SDMs, associated fauna, biodiversity, and bycatch.</span></a>
<a href="projects/#fisheries-dynamics"><strong>Fisheries dynamics & management</strong><span>Fleet and season dynamics, resource availability, biological risk, and adaptive management.</span></a>
<a href="projects/#scientific-computing"><strong>Scientific computing</strong><span>Statistical methods, reusable software, data infrastructure, and reproducible research workflows.</span></a>
</div>
